name: PYIN News
author: chuchua.tech
description: PYIN is a private, keyboard-first news reader with persistent navigation, local reading history, an editable interest graph, transparent ranking, 200 RSS feeds, alerts, and selectable source-bounded AI.

barWidget.description: Curated RSS news, model-free catalog search, an explainable local profile, source controls, instant synopses, saves, alerts, and optional AI.

schema.label: Refresh every (minutes)
schema.description: RSS refreshes and catalog search never invoke AI. Per-story AI summaries are on demand only.

schema.label: Extra interest keywords
schema.description: Optional comma-separated keywords beyond the setup wizard. Reading-choice learning is controlled from the in-app profile.

schema.label: Occasional split-flap logo
schema.description: Occasionally flip the four-letter PYIN masthead to NEWS while the feed is idle. Disable for a static logo.
